meta.overall_rationale: Brazil FeNb exports remain healthy through Sep 2026 (latest official month 8,859 t, inside/near the ~7–9 kt normal band after a soft MoM −16.3% from a strong Aug). CBMM spare capacity (~150 kt vs ~100 kt sales) and record CMOC 2025 output support continuity. Posture stays Watch—not Normal—because of extreme Araxá concentration plus standing yellow logistics/contractor-labor signals (MTE truck-corridor findings; Catalão Manserv/Metabase). No confirmed mine/plant interdiction in the live scan.
